root_text:
Two babies in Bengaluru diagnosed with HMPV, as per the Ministry of Health. A 3-month-old has recovered, while an 8-month-old is under treatment. Cases identified via ICMR’s respiratory illness surveillance. Stay informed, stay safe. 

#HMP
